title: Planning examination analysis reporting
text: Separate collection, examination, analysis and reporting. Describe methods and limitations. A methodical examination may justify no conclusion. Preserve the distinction between data extracted and the analyst’s interpretation.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Digital evidence authenticity preservation hashes
text: Preserve original evidence and document acquisition and processing. Hashes help identify changes in collected bytes; they do not independently authenticate the original author, sender, event or truth of a statement.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Chronology timestamps conflicting dates timezone
text: Record timestamp origin and timezone. Distinguish message date, claimed event date and file timestamps. Clock differences and copied files can affect interpretation. Preserve conflicting dates rather than choosing a convenient timeline.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Report conclusions uncertainty reproducibility
text: Present the examination process and analysis results clearly, including uncertainty and alternative explanations. Explain why additional examination would be useful and identify what the available data cannot establish.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Counter evidence exculpatory alternative hypothesis planning
text: Federal prosecution guidance addresses exculpatory and impeachment information, including information inconsistent with a charged element. For this evidence-assistance workflow, actively search for material that challenges a theory instead of only accumulating support. This is an investigative review practice, not a determination of disclosure obligations.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Witness credibility conflicting statements source reliability
text: Information undermining evidence accuracy or forensic conclusions can matter. Preserve inconsistent statements, limitations of examinations, and reliability concerns. Attribute expert assertions to their source and distinguish those assertions from analyses actually performed by this workflow.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Completeness electronic correspondence context
text: Electronic communications can contain relevant substantive information. Preserve their context and provenance during review. A retrieved excerpt or a search with no matches is not a complete review of all correspondence.
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Authentication identity aliases account attribution
text: Authentication concerns whether an item is what its proponent claims. Account labels, initials and matching aliases are leads, not conclusive proof of personal authorship. Identify what independent authentication would still be needed.
source_section: Federal Rules of Evidence, Rule 901; verify applicable edition
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Completeness exact quotations passage context
text: Evaluate excerpts in context. Retrieve surrounding statements when an isolated quotation could mislead. Preserve qualifiers, denials and contradictions; distinguish original wording from a translated or decoded representation.
source_section: Federal Rules of Evidence, Rule 106; verify applicable edition
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Expert opinion malware technical inference limitations
text: Separate specialized source opinions from observed facts. Describe the basis and limits of technical interpretations. Code labels and comments do not demonstrate execution, deployment, authorship or real-world consequences.
source_section: Federal Rules of Evidence, Rule 702; verify applicable edition
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Privilege lawyer counsel communications handling
text: Privilege requires applicable-law and context review. Flag potentially privileged communications for authorized human determination. Seeking legal advice must not itself be treated as evidence of guilt.
source_section: Federal Rules of Evidence, Rule 501; verify applicable edition
jurisdiction: US federal background; applicability and historical edition unverified

title: Financial calculation money transfer motive ordinary expenses
text: Recompute totals from complete recorded rows using decimal arithmetic. Separate budget, invoice, payment instruction, completed transfer, account ownership and confirmed proceeds. Ordinary consulting, travel and security spending can explain expenditures. Do not infer illicit money movement from a category or location.

title: Synthesis findings executive summary report review
text: Each finding must link exact evidence and distinguish source statements from inferred assessment. Explain support, contradiction and an ordinary alternative. Group identical copies as one underlying record. Do not infer guilt from graph centrality or communications. Unsupported conclusions stay out of the executive summary.

title: Jurisdiction legal framework authority historical applicability
text: No governing jurisdiction has been established by default. Guidance is background methodology, not case evidence or permission to contact people or acquire material. Do not assert legal elements, culpability, admissibility or charging recommendations without an applicable framework and qualified review. Current guidance does not establish historical law.

title: Planning enquiry execution stop sufficiency coverage
text: Review completed plans and accumulated findings. Choose a concrete enquiry, a counter-evidence question and completion criteria. Use graph structure to locate relevant records then retrieve source passages. Stop early when material enquiries are assessed; explicitly defer unresolved issues. Never continue just to spend the available budget.

title: Evidence integrity decoding source code incomplete retrieval
text: Decoded text must preserve its input span and reversible transformation. Never execute source code. Placeholder functions and simulations do not establish a deployed mechanism. Flag inconsistent dates, uncertain identities, unreadable records and partial retrieval; never repair these silently.
